ribbonSelectionColor.label: Unhide Sel+Off.
ribbonSelectionColor.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-eye "><path d="M10 12a2 2 0 1 0 4 0a2 2 0 0 0 -4 0"></path><path d="M21 12c-2.4 4 -5.4 6 -9 6c-3.6 0 -6.6 -2 -9 -6c2.4 -4 5.4 -6 9 -6c3.6 0 6.6 2 9 6"></path></svg>

ribbonSelectionColor.label: Unhide Each+Off.
ribbonSelectionColor.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-eye "><path d="M10 12a2 2 0 1 0 4 0a2 2 0 0 0 -4 0"></path><path d="M21 12c-2.4 4 -5.4 6 -9 6c-3.6 0 -6.6 -2 -9 -6c2.4 -4 5.4 -6 9 -6c3.6 0 6.6 2 9 6"></path></svg>
ribbonSelectionColor.tooltip: Unhide everything within the Fit Sel offset of EACH selected item individually (max 200 selected) — for scattered selections where one big box would cover too much

ribbonSelectionColor.label: Select Inside
ribbonSelectionColor.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-square-dot "><path d="M3 5a2 2 0 0 1 2 -2h14a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v14a2 2 0 0 1 -2 2h-14a2 2 0 0 1 -2 -2v-14"></path><path d="M11 12a1 1 0 1 0 2 0a1 1 0 1 0 -2 0"></path></svg>

ribbonSelectionColor.label: Select Intersecting
ribbonSelectionColor.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-layers-intersect "><path d="M8 6a2 2 0 0 1 2 -2h8a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v8a2 2 0 0 1 -2 2h-8a2 2 0 0 1 -2 -2l0 -8"></path><path d="M4 10a2 2 0 0 1 2 -2h8a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v8a2 2 0 0 1 -2 2h-8a2 2 0 0 1 -2 -2l0 -8"></path></svg>
ribbonSelectionColor.tooltip: Select every item whose bounds touch the clipping box or an enabled clip shape (inverted shapes are holes and are skipped)

ribbonSelectionColor.label: Colour swatches
ribbonSelectionColor.tooltip: Colour the selection with that swatch. Change the swatches in the Color Panel.

ribbonSelectionColor.tooltip: Clear the opacity override on the selection
